text:
maria: Quick status check on console observability roadmap — dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, retention decisions. Owners? Milestone targets: dashboards V1 by Thu, tracing hook canary next Tue, retention decision end-of-month. pinging @thomas @li @jamal @anna
thomas: Dashboard PR #812 is merged to staging, still needs smoke tests. Templates in `dashboards/console-v1.json`. Can someone run the smoke query? @maria could you review layout? :eyes:
li: Tracing hooks: instrumentation lib 0.9.1 is in QA. Sampling config is in infra repo. Quick snippet:
```
tracing:
  default_sample_rate: 0.05
  retention_days: 30
  hook_enabled: true
```
Need to confirm rate — start at 5% or 1% for canary? Also we can tag spans with `error=true` for server errors.
jamal: Retention note — lowering retention from 90 -> 30 days reduces storage ~45% on our estimate. Finance approval needed for 14-day options. Filed ticket FIN-452. If we pick 30d we can avoid backfill. Decision requested by Friday.
anna: From product: dashboards are highest priority for customers -> prioritize them first. I'll own rollout comms. For tracing, prioritize error/500 paths. Can the trace hook include `error=true` tag? @li
li: yes — hooks add `error=true` when status >=500. Plan: canary sampling = error spans 100%, baseline traffic 1%. I'll add config to canary.
thomas: Smoke test commands:
```
# run smoke
python tools/query_dash.py --dashboard console-v1 --env staging
```
I can run in ~30m unless someone else is quicker.
maria: please add a canary flag `obs.canary=true` to the staging rollout config and tag the PR with `canary`. thx.
thomas: done — PR #812 has `canary` label and smoke run comment. @maria pinged for review.
maria: reviewed, left one layout nit (legend order). Approved after fix. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: staging canary deployment successful — build 2026.3.12-214 passed health checks.
jamal: I added retention options to FIN-452 and pinged @finance. If finance greenlights 30d we use that as default and skip backfill; otherwise propose 14d + retention-backfill script (script in infra/tools/retention_backfill.py).
anna: Action items —
- thomas: finalize dashboard layout & run smoke (due EOD today)
- li: push tracing hook canary config, ensure error-only sampling (due Tue)
- jamal: follow up with finance on FIN-452 (due Fri)
- maria: coordinate canary rollout messaging & docs (due Tue)
I'll update roadmap doc after these.
maria: also reminder: add owners to the console/observability backlog entry and add a weekly check-in slot. Thanks everyone :rocket:
